# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-4434

# Review — PAN-4434
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — the issue's "manual idle-proxy check recorded in the PR" acceptance criterion is unmet (PR #4458 body has no record)

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-4434-review-9710e748
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4434/.pan/review/agent-pan-4434-review-9710e748/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-4434 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4434

- HEAD reviewed: 9710e74801edac9bea2d9e268a6cb49995ea94a2
- Base: merge-base with origin/main 8a82dad552bc (local `main` is stale; all diffs taken against the merge-base). Prior cycle: none.

## Blocking Findings

### [requirements] Manual idle-proxy acceptance check is not recorded in the PR — PR #4458 description
- Severity: ! (MUST)
- Classification / requirement scope: specification defect with a validation-gap consequence; in_pr_scope.
- Trigger and changed-code connection: The issue body's **Acceptance** section says: "Manual check recorded in the PR: a terminal left idle 10 minutes behind a proxy with a 100 s idle timeout stays connected." The PRD carries the same requirement as NFR-5 and AC-manual (`.pan/drafts/PAN-4434.md` lines 69 and 304). The xBRIEF spec (`.pan/specs/2026-10-01-PAN-4434-…xbrief.json`) dropped it, so no plan item or task ever asked the work agent to do it. The PR body lists only the five plan items.
- Expected / observed / impact: Expected a recorded real-proxy soak result in the PR description. Observed: none. The only evidence is a fake-timer unit test and an in-process wiring test. Neither exercises the failure this feature exists to fix: a real reverse proxy treating the NUL-prefixed data frame as traffic and keeping an idle browser terminal connected past its idle timeout.
- Evidence: PR body fetched via `api.github.com/repos/eltmon/overdeck/pulls?head=eltmon:feature/pan-4434` (gh CLI was unauthenticated); `grep -n -i "manual\|NFR-5"` on the spec and continue file finds nothing; issue body fetched via REST API.
- Fix: Run the check (dashboard terminal behind a proxy with a 100 s idle timeout, tab kept visible, idle 10 minutes, no reconnect overlay) and record the result in the PR description. Alternatively the operator rewrites or waives the AC on the issue. Spec correction: the planner should carry issue-body ACs (including manual ones) into the xBRIEF.

## Non-blocking Findings

### [correctness] Pings reset the one-shot 4404 retry latch — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/XTerminal.tsx` (onmessage, `sessionNotFoundRetried.current = false`)
- Severity: ~ (SHOULD)
- Classification: implementation behavior change; in_pr_scope.
- Trigger: Every inbound message clears `sessionNotFoundRetried`. Before this PR nothing arrived before the snapshot, so the latch reset only on real data. Now the server pings every 20 s from connection onward, including during the ≤95 s `RESPAWN_WAIT_MS` respawn wait in `resolveTerminalAttachTarget`. A connection that waits ≥20 s and then gets 4404 is treated as a first 4404 and retried again.
- Impact: Bounded. Once `pendingRespawns` clears, the next attempt returns 4404 without a ping and the latch holds. Arguably desirable while a respawn is still pending, but it changes PAN-3921's "single retry" contract.
- Fix: Reset the latch only on non-heartbeat traffic (move the reset after the ping branch, or skip it for ping frames).

### [requirements] New frontend tests are not run by `npm test` or CI — `package.json` `test:frontend-subset`
- Severity: ~ (SHOULD)
- Classification: validation gap; pre-existing pattern (XTerminal.test.tsx was already outside the subset).
- Evidence: `test:frontend-subset` is a curated file list; neither `src/components/XTerminal.test.tsx` nor `src/components/terminal/terminalControlFrames.test.ts` is in it. CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml` line 234) runs only that subset plus Playwright. FR-5/FR-6/FR-7 coverage runs only by hand.
- Fix: Add both files to `test:frontend-subset`.

### [correctness] Primitive JSON after NUL is now dropped — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/terminal/terminalControlFrames.ts`
- Severity: ? (MAY)
- `parseTerminalControlFrame` casts `JSON.parse` output, so `\u00001` or `\u0000"x"` return a non-null primitive and XTerminal's `if (control !== null) return` drops them. Before the PR they fell through to xterm. FR-6 promises malformed frames keep pass-through; these are valid JSON, not objects. `\u0000null` still passes through. PTY output beginning with NUL plus a JSON primitive is rare. Fix if desired: return null unless the parse result is a non-null object.

### Verified, not findings
- Ping/pong client messages are dropped on connections without `heartbeat=1` too. This matches FR-3 ("on any of the four handler paths"); non-goal 3 forbids only heartbeat pings and termination there.
- A user typing or pasting exactly `{"type":"pong"}` is swallowed. That is the same pre-existing class as `ready`/`resize`, and bracketed paste wraps real pastes so they do not start with `{`.

## Coverage

| --- | --- |

| `src/dashboard/server/ws-terminal.ts` | Reviewed. Heartbeat started after session/reauth checks only when `heartbeat=1`; ping uses `sendControl` (OPEN-guarded). Ping/pong dropped at the single `ws.on('message')` entry before `messageHandler` and `bufferPreAttachMessage`, so the Herdr bridge, PTY hub, join path, pending input and pre-attach buffer never see them (grep confirms one `ws.on('message')`). Upgrade/auth block untouched. |
| `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/XTerminal.tsx` | Reviewed. URL adds `&heartbeat=1`; ping answered with exactly one pong and returned; unknown control objects dropped; malformed falls through. Net −11 lines. See 4404-latch advisory. |
| `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/terminal/terminalControlFrames.ts` | Reviewed. See primitive-JSON advisory. |
| `src/dashboard/server/__tests__/ws-terminal-heartbeat.test.ts` | Reviewed. Six cases under fake timers. |
| `src/dashboard/server/__tests__/ws-terminal-heartbeat-wiring.test.ts` | Reviewed. Real ws server; three named cases; included by root vitest `src/**/__tests__/**`. |
| `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/XTerminal.test.tsx` | Reviewed. Three new cases; not in CI subset (advisory). |
| `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/terminal/terminalControlFrames.test.ts` | Reviewed. Not in CI subset (advisory). |
| `docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md` | Reviewed. Accurate to shipped behavior. |
| `docs/DASHBOARD-AUTH.md` | Reviewed. Accurate. |
| `configuration/remote-access.mdx` | Reviewed. Accurate; not-yet-shipped bullet removed. |
| `.pan/drafts/PAN-4434.md`, `.pan/specs/…xbrief.json`, `.pan/continues/PAN-4434.xbrief.json` | Reviewed as planning artifacts; spec omits AC-manual (blocking finding). |

### Dimensions
- Correctness: no defect in the server heartbeat or filtering; one bounded client behavior change (4404 latch) and one rare edge (primitive JSON).
- Security: no new trust boundary. Opt-in query param is read after auth; ping/pong cannot inject input; termination only affects the caller's own socket. No auth, ws-auth.ts or route-scopes.ts change.
- Performance: one 20 s interval per opted-in socket plus one extra JSON.parse per inbound message (already parsed in handlers). Negligible; no blocking I/O.
- Requirements/UX: all FRs met in code; AC-manual unmet (blocking); new frontend tests not in the normal test command (advisory).

### Acceptance criteria

| AC-W1 heartbeat unit tests | Met | 6 cases pass under fake timers (local run, 13/13 with W2+auth). |

| NFR-2 no cycle | Met | module imports only a type from `ws`. |

### Non-goals
No `ws.ping(` call (only a comment); `/ws/rpc`, voice, autopreso, events untouched; `ws-auth.ts`, `route-scopes.ts`, `terminalReconnectPolicy.ts`, `file-size-allowlist.txt` unchanged vs merge-base; no server reply to client ping; no heartbeat without opt-in.

## Verification
- CI on exact HEAD 9710e748 (check-runs via GitHub REST API; `gh` was unauthenticated): test, test-shard 1–4, lint, lint-group core/effect/skills/state, build (22), Clean install + server smoke, test-e2e, Prompt change trailer gate, Non-blocking flake lane — all success; `overdeck/verification` status success; CodeRabbit success. `lint:effect-diagnostics` runs in lint-group (effect) per `scripts/run-lint-group.mjs` — green.
- Local focused: `npx vitest run` heartbeat, heartbeat-wiring, ws-terminal-auth → 3 files, 13 tests passed. Frontend `npx vitest run src/components/XTerminal.test.tsx src/components/terminal/terminalControlFrames.test.ts` → 2 files, 42 tests passed.
- `bash scripts/lint-file-size.sh` → exit 0.
- Not run: full suite (CI owns it); `lint:circular` locally (covered by CI lint; module has only a type import); live proxy soak (outside review budget, and is the blocking AC itself).
